# Code blocks

A language named after the fence:

```rust
fn main() {
    println!("Hello, world!");
}
```

Only the first word of the info string names it:

```python title="greet.py"
def greet(name):
    return f"Hello, {name}!"
```

No language:

```
plain text
```
